thing-type.label: Generic Bluetooth Device
thing-type.description: A generic bluetooth device that supports GATT characteristics

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: The frequency at which readable characteristics refreshed

parameter.name: alwaysConnected
parameter.label: Connect Automatically
parameter.description: If enabled, will automatically connect to the device and reconnect if connection is lost.

parameter.name: connectionSecurity
parameter.label: Connection Security
parameter.description: LE connection security for this device. "none" (default) connects unbonded with no encryption — the proven, dead-stable profile suitable for open sensors. "auto" requests Just-Works encryption (no passkey/MITM) and keeps it STRICT: it never downgrades, so use it for devices that must never talk unencrypted (e.g. locks). "encrypted-preferred" also requests encryption but automatically falls back to an unencrypted connection if the device pairs and then cannot reconnect (an address-resolution limitation), so availability is preserved for devices where that matters more than confidentiality. Leave on "none" unless a device actually rejects reads without encryption. NOTE: the encrypted modes are EXPERIMENTAL. Currently honoured by the Direct-BT adapter; other adapters ignore it.

options.option: Encrypted preferred (fall back to unencrypted — experimental)

parameter.name: passkey
parameter.label: Passkey (PIN)
parameter.description: The 6-digit passkey/PIN used when Connection Security is "pin" (authenticated Passkey Entry pairing). Enter the fixed PIN the device expects (0–999999). Ignored for the other security modes. Note: this is stored in the Thing configuration; treat it as a secret.

channel-type.label: Unknown Bluetooth Characteristic
channel-type.description: The raw value of unknown characteristics are represented with hexadecimal
